title: Twenty-two years
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-two. The corn. The Sunday is a third of a page now. The corn is full size. The strip notes the proportion.

panels.composition: The garage. Corn, full size. Beside it, the Newport weekly: the Sunday, a third of a page, tiny. WOOD. BARNABY II.
props: the tiny Sunday in the paper

image.prompt: a man at a drafting table with a full tray of corn beside a newspaper where a comic Sunday page has been printed at a third of its size, a three-legged dog, clean ink

panels.composition: The corn and the Sunday, to scale. The corn wins.

image.prompt: close-up of a paper tray of corn dwarfing a tiny printed comic page beside it

balloons.text: Twenty-two years. The corn's the same size it was in 1997. That's more than I can say for the Sunday.

image.prompt: a man speaking to a dog while holding a tiny newspaper page next to a tray of corn

panels.composition: Alone at the long surface. The corn. The small Sunday. The small mark.

notes: The corn is the same size. The Sunday isn't.
